name: build-brief
description: On explicit invocation, translate software intent into an approval-ready developer design contract with a faithful plain-language explanation.

interface.longDescription: When explicitly invoked, Build Brief translates a software request and repository context into the smallest developer Design Contract that preserves the required behavior. It shows a faithful plain-language explanation, waits for explicit approval, and never replaces design translation with phases, steps, tasks, or execution order. After approval, the ordinary coding workflow plans and implements against the contract. Without invocation it adds no session context and blocks nothing.
defaultPrompt: Translate this request into the smallest sufficient developer design contract, explain the same contract plainly, and wait for approval before implementation.
Create an approval-ready design contract and plain-language explanation for this change without producing a task plan.
Turn this request into a design-only handoff with a faithful plain-language explanation and no implementation steps.
